name: Sparse Distance-Field Cache for Interactive Camera Moves
aliases: Sparse distance-field cache for interactive 3D camera moves
definition: A technique to optimize interactive 3D camera moves (orbit/dolly) over an unchanged fractal by baking the distance field (DE) once into a sparse brick volume, allowing raymarching of the cache instead of re-evaluating the expensive fractal DE formula every frame.
summary: This method optimizes interactive camera navigation over fractal surfaces by baking distance estimators into a sparse 3D brick volume, decoupling geometric query cost from frame rate.
